rows.description: A charismatic speaker online makes life feel clear and meaningful, and I watch every video. Wise: enjoy what helps, but compare it with other sources and note what it asks of me.

rows.description: I start believing this preacher has all the answers and see others as lost. Harmful: a single voice takes over my thinking. Wise: stay curious, keep diverse friends, and check claims.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, admiration, argument, disillusionment, manipulation, protectiveness

rows.description: A preacher uses guilt, fear and us-versus-them to make me donate or cut off family. Recognise it: real guidance does not demand secrecy, money or isolation. Talk to a trusted adult.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, admiration, argument, disillusionment, protectiveness, worship
related mind states: fear, guilt, loneliness, trust

rows.description: I argue with my parent about a preacher they trust and I doubt. Wise: ask what they find helpful, share specific concerns, and avoid ridiculing them.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, admiration, disillusionment, manipulation, protectiveness, worship
related mind states: doubt, trust

rows.description: I discover that the preacher I admired lives against his own words and earns from followers. I feel foolish and angry. Wise: keep the teachings that were true, and not blame myself for hope.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, admiration, argument, manipulation, protectiveness, worship
related mind states: admiration, anger, hope

rows.description: A friend is pulled into an extreme online group and changes. Wise: stay their friend, ask questions with warmth, avoid mocking, and involve a trusted adult if they are cut off or at risk.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, admiration, argument, disillusionment, manipulation, worship
related mind states: affection, trust

rows.description: Their community welcomes me warmly when I feel unseen at home. The warmth is real, yet warmth alone is not proof of truth. Wise: also build offline friendships.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, argument, disillusionment, manipulation, protectiveness, worship
related mind states: affection, nostalgia

rows.description: Someone mocks the leader or cause I support and I flare up. Wise: pause, ask what they mean, and separate a person from their view. Harmful: insulting or trolling.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: argument, confusion, contempt, hatred, manipulation
related mind states: anger

rows.description: I start to see the other side as stupid or evil. It feels good and makes me lonely. Wise: notice the stereotype, meet one real person from that side, and hold my view with humility.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, argument, confusion, hatred, manipulation
related mind states: contempt, loneliness

rows.description: I am abused online for my opinion or my religion. Wise: do not reply in kind, block, save proof, tell a trusted adult, and remember that disagreement is not permission for cruelty.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, argument, confusion, contempt, manipulation
related mind states: trust
